title: cluster-mcp-servers definition inputs
description: The closed input set of the cluster-mcp-servers capability: a management cluster's own MCP servers (mcp-kubernetes, mcp-prometheus, mcp-capi) on an installation without the agent platform, released from the fleet's bases into extras/mcp-<name> of its management-clusters repository. The renderer turns these inputs into each server's directory — the kustomization over the fleet base, the OAuth credentials and valkey-auth Secrets, the Dex client's Secret, the credentials revision Secret the server's and its Valkey's HelmReleases read into their charts' checksum values so a rotation restarts both, and the user values where Dex is private — and each server's Dex client as a referenced Secret in the installation's dex-app configmap patch. Where the agent platform is enabled, the agent-platform definition renders the same servers and this one refuses. Annotations: x-source says where a value comes from (registry: read from the installations registry, never typed; person: typed by the person enabling or reconciling). x-feature names the consistency feature of features.yaml the input's dimensions roll up to. x-files names the repository file a fileset key is read back from (<name> the installation). servers.<server>.enabled is read from the record (Capability.RecordInputs). x-readback on a person input names the file and key its value is read back from on record and lays the value over the record (kind value, present — whether the key exists — or file — whether the file is on record). x-renders lists the key paths the input produces, prefixed by the file: extras (a file under the installation's extras/), dex-configmap (the dex-app configmap patch).

installation.description: The facts on record. Read from the installations registry, the installation's config.yaml.patch and the cluster App's manifest; never typed and never in the form.

name.description: The installation's codename; it names the generated values, so no credential is shared between installations.

baseDomain.description: The installation's base domain, where its Dex answers the anonymous probes.

customer.description: The owning organisation as the configs and management-clusters repositories name it.

dexAppVersion.description: The dex-app the installation runs, read as the agent-platform definition reads it. A version older than 3.2.3 refuses the render: from 3.2.3 Dex restarts when a referenced client Secret changes, so a rotation of a server's Dex client secret reaches Dex; before it Dex keeps the old secret and the server's sign-ins fail until a hand-run restart. An absent version refuses nothing.

agentPlatform.description: Whether agent-platform is on record for the installation. Then the agent-platform definition renders the installation's MCP servers and this one refuses.

enabled.description: mcp-kubernetes runs on the installation. On an installation with the capability on record, read from the record: whether extras/mcp-kubernetes/kustomization.yaml is there; a fresh enable runs every server. Without it the render has no mcp-kubernetes directory and no Dex client for it.

privateURLs.description: Dex is reached on private addresses: mcp-kubernetes's OAuth issuer URL may resolve to a private IP, and so may its SSO forwarded-token JWKS fetch, in the server's user values.

dexCA.description: Dex is served with a certificate from the installation's private CA: mcp-kubernetes's kustomization lists the installation's own Secret mcp-kubernetes-dex-ca (mcp-kubernetes/dex-ca-secret.enc.yaml, never rendered) and the user values point the chart at it.

privateIPs.description: The clients' metadata documents and redirect URIs are on private addresses too (a private installation): mcp-kubernetes's CIMD fetch and redirect URI checks allow private IPs.

enabled.description: mcp-prometheus runs on the installation. On an installation with the capability on record, read from the record: whether extras/mcp-prometheus/kustomization.yaml is there; a fresh enable runs every server. Without it the render has no mcp-prometheus directory and no Dex client for it.
